subject: Wrong charge on my invoice
body: I was charged $49.99 twice this month. My invoice shows two identical line items for the same subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.

subject: Someone hacked my account
body: I cannot access my account. I received an email saying my password was changed but I did not do it. Someone has taken over my account. I need immediate help.

subject: Dashboard not loading
body: The dashboard has been showing a spinner for the past hour. I have tried clearing cache and using a different browser. Nothing works. This is blocking my team.

subject: Cannot log into my account
body: I forgot my password and reset it, but the new password is still not working. I am locked out of my account. Please help me regain access.

subject: How do I export my data?
body: I would like to export all my project data as a CSV file. Could you point me to the right documentation or tell me how to do this? No rush.

subject: Refund not received
body: I requested a refund two weeks ago and was told it would arrive in 5-7 business days. It has been 14 days and I still have not received anything. My order number is ORD-8821.

subject: Account email changed without my knowledge
body: I noticed my account email was changed to an address I do not recognise. I did not make this change. I am worried my account has been compromised. Please lock it immediately.

subject: API returning 500 errors
body: Our integration is getting 500 Internal Server Error on the /v2/reports endpoint since this morning. This is breaking our production pipeline. Urgent fix needed.

subject: Need help setting up SSO
body: We are trying to set up SAML SSO for our organisation but are stuck on the attribute mapping step. Is there a guide or can someone walk us through it?

subject: Questions about enterprise pricing
body: We are considering upgrading to the Enterprise plan. Could you send me details about the pricing tiers, what is included, and whether there is an annual discount?

subject: Subscription cancelled without notice
body: My subscription was cancelled and I did not request it. I am still being shown ads as if I am on the free plan. Was I charged for a cancellation? I need this fixed today.

subject: Suspicious login from another country
body: I got a security alert that someone logged into my account from a location I have never been to. I have changed my password but I am concerned the attacker still has access.

subject: CSV export crashes on large files
body: When I try to export more than 10,000 rows as CSV the page freezes and eventually shows an error. Smaller exports work fine. Can this be fixed?

subject: Update my billing address
body: I recently moved and need to update the billing address on my account. The address on the invoices is my old one. How do I change it in settings?

subject: How do I add a team member?
body: I want to invite a colleague to my workspace. I looked in settings but could not find where to send an invite. Could you guide me?

subject: Charged after cancelling
body: I cancelled my subscription on the 1st but was still charged on the 3rd. I have a cancellation confirmation email. I want a full refund for this charge.

subject: Webhook not firing for new events
body: We set up a webhook endpoint but it has not received any events for the last 24 hours. The endpoint is live and returning 200. Something changed on your end.

subject: Change account username
body: I would like to change my username from my old email handle to my actual name. Is this possible and will it affect my login?

subject: Two-factor authentication not working
body: My authenticator app codes are being rejected. I have synced the time on my phone. This is preventing my entire team from logging in. Urgent.

subject: What integrations do you support?
body: Before we commit to upgrading our plan I want to know which third-party tools you integrate with natively. Do you have a Zapier or Slack integration?
